subject: Novacare security intake — SOC 2 evidence request & intake actions

Subject: Post-demo: security intake & required artifacts for procurement

Hi Dustin / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your procurement and security teams can progress: 

1) What we can share immediately:
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) — attached as a redacted copy for your intake team.
- Bridge letter template if you need a short attestation pending distribution of the full report.
- Short intake questionnaire (attached) that aligns with typical vendor DDQs — fill what you can and we’ll follow up on the rest.

2) Info you mentioned you need from us:
- SOC 2 coverage dates and scope (in the PDF header).
- GDPR/HIPAA posture summary and contact for DPA / Data Processing questions.
- Preferred way to get you trust-portal access (we can invite an admin contact or create a read-only link).

3) Proposed immediate asks for Novacare: 
- Please confirm the security contact(s) we should add to the trust portal.
- If you have a vendor questionnaire URL (or DocuSign/OneTrust link), send it back and we’ll begin the intake.
- If you want the bridge letter notarized/signed, let us know the recipient name/email for DocuSign.

I’ve attached: redwood_soc2_typeii_2026.pdf (redacted), redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx, intake_questionnaire_v2.xlsx

I’ll loop in Neha (our security lead) to answer technical questions. Happy to set a short follow-up call this week.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the attachments. A couple clarifying items from our side before we push to procurement: 

- Can you confirm the SOC 2 Type II period covered (start/end dates) and whether the report includes third-party subservice orgs?
- Do you have a short GDPR/HIPAA one-pager or statement of applicability we can share with our legal team?
- For the bridge letter: is the template intended as an interim attestation until the finalized 3rd-party report is delivered? We sometimes need a signed version for our compliance gate.

Also — we prefer the trust portal invite to go to vendor-security@novacare.com (Priya). If possible please provide a time-limited role (read-only) for procurement reviewers.

Finally, we have a OneTrust vendor intake form. I can send the link if you prefer — it has about ~40 fields we usually pre-populate.

Thanks,
Dustin Miller
Head of Procurement | Novacare Health
dustin@novacare.com

Hi Dustin / Priya —

Thanks for the questions. I’m Redwood’s security lead and can answer the items Dustin outlined. Short answers below with pointers: 

- SOC 2 Type II period: coverage is 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31. The attached PDF is a redacted copy; the full report (non-redacted) is available in our trust portal by invite. Subservice orgs: we use a small set of cloud providers; relevant third-party coverage is summarized in Appendix B of the full report.

- GDPR/HIPAA posture: We are not a HIPAA-covered entity by default, but we support HIPAA-compliant deployments (BAA available on request for Private customers). For GDPR: we have a DPA template and standard data processing terms — I can share the two-page summary as a separate document.

- Bridge letter: yes — the attached template is intended for interim attestation while you wait for the final, non-redacted report to be provisioned. We can sign via DocuSign; please provide the recipient name/email for signing.

Trust portal access: I’ve provisioned an invite link for vendor-security@novacare.com (sent separately via our portal system). The invite is read-only for 'compliance reviewer' and expires in 14 days. If you need an extension, reply to this thread and we’ll extend.

Requested from Novacare: if you can share the OneTrust vendor intake URL we’ll pre-fill the questionnaire and return within 48 business hours. Also please confirm whether you require a notarized bridge letter or a signed PDF — both options are possible.

Attachments I’m including here: redwood_soc2_typeii_2026.pdf (same redacted copy), redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx. Additional: I’ll upload the DPA summary separately.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai

- Timeline: ideally we’d have a signed bridge letter and completed basic questionnaire by close of business Friday (2027-07-02) to stay on the procurement calendar for July.

If you can confirm DocuSign recipient (I’ll add the name to the intake), we’ll route it internally for signature.
